create_FlowNetS_model: create a FlowNetS optical flow estimation model with configurable input channels and batch normalization
run_FlowNetS_forward: run the FlowNetS forward pass on an input tensor to predict optical flow fields
review_FlowNetS_encoder_decoder: review the FlowNetS encoder-decoder architecture with six convolutional stages and four deconvolutional stages
summarize_FlowNetS_multi_scale_flow: summarize the FlowNetS multi-scale flow prediction layers that output flow at five resolution levels
test_FlowNetS_training_inference: test the FlowNetS model returning multi-scale flow during training and single flow during inference
